rubric.text: Chooses parents by an adaptive threshold relative to the best measured fitness so far - keeping everything within a small fraction of the best - rather than a fixed top-k or the single best sequence.
Generates children from those parents by per-position mutation at a rate of about one over the sequence length, and by recombining parents.

Extends each child by repeated mutation for as long as a surrogate model says it is still at least as good as its parent, stopping that walk when the surrogate score drops - a rollout, not a single mutation step.
Fits a surrogate model to the measurements collected so far and uses it to screen a candidate pool much larger than the measurement batch.
Spends the real measurement budget only on the top-scoring candidates from that pool, staying within the batch size each round.

provenance: Rubric written from arXiv:2010.02141 Alg. 1 and Secs. 3-4 before any scored run.
